title: Relay Service Layer — shared Dart HTTP client for Yeshie + Contabo
description:
Foundation singleton for all Pulse screen network calls.

BACKGROUND: The relay lives at localhost:3333 (Yeshie) on Mike's Mac — confirmed live 2026-05-11. The app's WebShell already has _QuickCaptureBar that POSTs to Settings.yeshieHost(). Each screen currently re-implements its own HTTP logic (or is a stub). This bead extracts a shared RelayService dart class so every screen talks through one place.

SCOPE:
- lib/src/relay_service.dart — singleton RelayService with:
  - sendMessage(String text) → POST /relay/message (→ Dee)
  - fetchMessages({int since}) → GET /relay/messages?since=N (polling for Dee replies)
  - fetchJobs() → GET /relay/jobs (fleet status)
  - dispatchJob(String name, String prompt) → POST /relay/dispatch
  - fetchActivity({int limit}) → GET /relay/activity
  - fetchCards() → GET /relay/cards
  - actionCard(String cardId, String actionId) → POST /relay/cards/action
  - Health check: GET /relay/health
- Reads base URL from Settings.yeshieHost() on init; re-reads on each call so live config changes work.
- Auth header support: reads optional X-SOMA-Token from Settings (empty = no header sent). Required for Contabo path; optional for local relay.
- Error model: RelayException(statusCode, body) — screens handle gracefully, never crash on network error.
- Retry: 1 automatic retry on 5xx (not on 4xx).
- Timeout: configurable, default 10s.

RATIONALE: Without this, each screen reimplements HTTP logic. With it, a screen is 30 lines of UI wrapping service calls. This is the unlock for the entire screen sprint.

DONE CRITERIA:
- RelayService.instance works in a running app
- sendMessage round-trips to the relay (Pixel or emulator + Mac relay running)
- Unit tests mock HttpClient; test all public methods' happy + error paths
- No screen directly imports package:http
